overviewRepairFixtureState: Explicitly false on boot; tests exercise true and false independently of the product default.

scope.ui: Actual HTML, WholeNativeViewer, SurfacePane and NativeEdgeLoader with LinkeDOM, fixture worker messages and a mock WebGL API. No browser pixels or device performance were measured.
scope.worker: Actual worker module with in-memory HTTP Response fixtures and structuredClone transfer lists, including real gzip decoding, SHA-256 validation, NBE1 meshing, cleanup and HFM face filtering.
scope.data: Synthetic 129-cubed native plane plus a detached 27-sample island, and a three-face synthetic HFM overview. No claim of anatomical validation.

uiAssertions: Native default and initial worker request are cleaned.
Original and Removed requests preserve the previous geometry and descriptive mode labels until all eight pieces and their done result commit.
Same-block mode changes preserve yaw, pitch, center, pan and span; overview camera and requests remain independent.
Rapid mode changes coalesce; stale pieces, stale success results and superseded pending requests cannot commit.
A failed switch restores the displayed Original selector, geometry and labels, and releases the staged meshes.
Both cleanup controls remain disabled when WebGL creation fails; no geometry worker job starts.
Overview repair is explicit and independent; its failed replacement restores the displayed checkbox state and retains its previous meshes and labels.

failureCasesBeforePieceEmission: Validly hashed mask with wrong popcount
Validly hashed mask with nonzero padding
overviewFixtureAssertions.aggregateSourceCountValidation: An aggregate source-count mismatch is rejected in the final result even when a filtered piece has already been staged. The UI tests separately verify that staged pieces do not commit before a successful complete result.
